tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// he ru ka'i zhing du 'dren pa'i smon lam yid kyi shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs/

"$ ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ ma lus 'gro ba thams cad kyi rmongs pa'i mun pa dgag par byed cing*/ ma rungs pa thams cad 'joms pa'i dpa' bo dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la btud de gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// drang srong khros pa'i gzugs 'chang mun pa'i mdog la bskal pa'i me 'phro 'jig rten gsum gnon zhing*// rigs lngas bkod pa chen po'i mdun bsus drag po'i gtsug na g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis gar mdzad pa// dbang phyug chen po'i 'byor pas phyug pa'i bcu gnyis phyag brgyangs ha ha rgod pa'i gdong bzhi'i spyan// dag pa'i chos kyi bu mor chags nas gsang ba kun bshad he ru ka der phyag 'tshal lo// bandhū dzi wa ka yi mdangs 'phrog ma lus snying la rmongs pa'i mun pa 'gog byed pa// zag med bde ba'i ngang du rol mdzad 'gro la brtse ldan thugs rje mnga' ba'i spyan yangs sku// the tshom zug rngu'i dra ba gcod phyir phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba nam mkha'i dbyings la rol// g.yon pa thod pa inḍas gang 'dzin rgyal ba skyed byed yum mchog de la phyag 'tshal lo// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la 'khod g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis gar mdzad pad nyi ro gdan la bzhugs nas// drag mo'i gzugs 'chang zhal gcig phyag bzhi thod pa rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan byas shing*// stong nyid bde ba'i ngang du rol phyir gcer mo phyag rgya lnga yis rab tu spras gyur pa// sna tshogs gzugs 'dzin ma rungs 'joms mdzad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos sgron// dri chab zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag rnams// dngos 'byor yid sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// de ltar bstod cing mchod pa'i mthur brten nas// bdag sogs 'gro ba sems can ma lus kun// 'di nas gzung ste byang chub ma thob bar// he ru ka yi dam chos 'dzin gyur cig

/gzhan yang sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyi// tsha bas nyam thag bsil zhing bde ba dang*// grang bas nyam thag drod thob tshe 'phos te// khrag 'thung chen po'i go 'phang bgrod par shog /lo ma ral gri'i nags tshal de dag kyang*// tsan dan nags sogs mdzes pa'i shing gyur te// mi snyan sgra rnams snyan par thos byas nas// 'khor lo sdom pa'i sa la 'khod gyur cig /gcan gzan 'jigs dang thig nag bsdus 'joms dang*// sa sreg la sogs dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal kun// myur du grol te bde dang ldan gyur nas// dpa' bo chen po'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal ji snyed kyang*// bkres pa tshim zhing skom pa las grol te// ser sna med cing 'byor pa dang ldan nas// ri khrod chen po'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /dud 'gro rnams ni gcig la gcig za dang*// glen lkugs bkol spyod sdug bsngal la sogs pa// ma lus grol te bde dang ldan gyur nas// 'khor lo mgon po'i sa la 'khod gyur cig /lha la 'chi 'pho ltung byed sdug bsngal dang*// lha min 'thab rtsod mtshon cha 'phangs rigs rnams// me tog char gyur phrag dog zhi byas nas// zla ba'i thod can go 'phang thob par shog /gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di nang sdug bsngal dag /skye rga na 'chi dbul phongs la sogs pa// myur du grol zhing bde ba dang ldan te// he ru ka yi sa la 'khod gyur cig /de ltar smon pa 'di nyid btab pa'i mthus// bdag sogs 'khor ba'i sems can ji snyed pa// mi khom gnas spang dal 'byor rnyed byas te// he ru ka yi dam chos spyod par shog /dam chos spyod pa'i lus su skyes nas kyang*// dad brtson shes rab snying rje ldan pa dang*// slob ma'i mtshan tshang rdo rje theg zhugs nas// smin byed dbang thob rim gnyis ldan gyur cig /gzhan yang ma rungs rmongs pa'i sems can rnams// 'phrin las bzhi yis gang 'dul skur bstan te// rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i thugs rje'i spyan yangs kyis// 'gro rnams rdo rje'i sa la 'khod par shog

/he ru ka mchog dus su mchod pa'i mthus// bdag kyang khrag 'thung chen po'i gan bgrod nas// sems can kun gyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dang*// thar pa khrid pa'i grogs dan byed gyur cig /gzhan yang 'khor ba'i sems can ji snyed pa// ma bsgral ba rnams myur du bsgral ba dang*// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung bgyis byas te// 'gro rnams 'khor lo sdom pa'i sa thob shog/ // ces pa 'di yang bkra shis mon mo rdza'i ri khrod du/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor pa ngag gi dbang po rnam par rgyal bas sbyar ba/ sems can thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang thob gyur cig/ nyes ltung dri mas ma gos shing*// rlabs chen spyod pa rdzogs pa dang*// he ru ka dang mnyam pa yi// go 'phang tshe 'dir thob par shog/ //
